description: NIP-44 v2 KAT fixture for @senn/signaling-nostr v2 (ADR-0027 §5). Deterministic round-trip against nostr-tools/nip44.encrypt with fixed conversationKey + fixed nonce. The construction-time KAT (src/v2.ts runConstructionTimeKAT) re-runs this round-trip on every adapter instantiation that enables v2; a mismatch detects an upstream nostr-tools envelope-format regression (e.g., a future major bump introducing v3) at the SENN boundary rather than at the first peer-to-peer message. To regenerate after a deliberate vector update, run `node -e "..."` against the upstream module — see scripts/verify-nostr-self-test.ts for the regeneration helper.
